description: React component for displaying and managing integrations in a web app, including fetching data, filtering, and rendering integration cards and modals.

methods.name: loadIntegrations
methods.description: Fetches integration data from API endpoint and updates state; falls back to mock data on failure.

methods.name: handleCreateSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful creation of an integration, closes modal, reloads data, and shows success toast.
